world: A single painted storyboard image with twelve equal panels, four across and three down, read left to right. Early morning Colombo daylight is warm and low from screen right, with soft canopy shade, restrained colour and muted urban surroundings throughout. All people are smooth artist's mannequins of consistent adult proportions: Kasun red, the customer blue, and incidental distant people neutral grey. The humble food three-wheeler has dull green bodywork, a shallow faded canvas canopy, a chipped green canopy upright and a scratched steel counter. Props are rendered realistically: a stainless tea flask with a dark handle and removable lid, a dented kettle, a metal tray of short eats, a plain ceramic tea cup and a beige cleaning cloth. The service cup is concealed before its first appearance at the customer edge of the counter. Enclosed traffic vehicles have obscured occupants. No lettering, panel labels, captions, symbols or arrows appear anywhere.
geography: The three-wheeler stands along the pavement, with its body and recessed preparation bay to screen left and the Colombo road opening to screen right. The counter projects from the shaded bay toward the customer standing area; a narrow inner work surface returns into the vehicle. The chipped canopy upright marks the left side of the serving opening, while the same road and kerb continue along the right. With no supplied axis, the roadside master establishes Kasun left and the customer right: the customer approaches across frame toward the left and departs across frame toward the right. Most cameras stay on this roadside side of their exchange; the elevated view observes the same arrangement from above. The interior reaction camera stands just inside the bay, offset from Kasun's working line, retaining a wedge of road brightness at frame right. The final customer-side oblique view preserves the green vehicle left and road right.
conflicts: Shot 3 is labelled WIDE, but its detailed framing specifies EWS; the elevated extreme-wide framing is used.
Shot 7 is labelled MS, but its detailed framing specifies MWS; the medium-wide serving-bay framing is used.
Shot 10 is labelled CU, but its detailed framing specifies ECU; the hand-and-flask extreme close insert is used.
Shot 9 contains a spoken line later in the shot, but its explicit opening has Kasun still directed into the vehicle. The panel preserves that opening pose rather than the later road-facing delivery.

panels.camera: Standing head height from the roadside, looking obliquely across the serving side; wide, 35mm lens feel, deep focus.
panels.background: Green vehicle body, shaded fittings and chipped canopy upright occupy frame left. The kerb and road recede across frame right, with a distant bus, tuk-tuk and motorcycle.
panels.picture: The red Kasun mannequin stands behind the counter in the left two-thirds, chest facing screen right and head tipped toward the food tray. Its left hand holds the flask beside the counter, while its right hand is poised beside the arranged short eats. On the distant road at frame right, a small grey motorcycle rider faces screen right, with both hands on the handlebars and feet on the rests.

panels.camera: Counter-height three-quarter view from the roadside, looking across Kasun's working line; waist-up medium shot, 50mm lens feel.
panels.background: Soft green fittings and the chipped canopy upright remain frame left. A softly separated strip of road brightness remains at frame right; the service cup is outside the frame.
panels.picture: The red mannequin occupies the left and centre, chest facing diagonally screen right toward the vessels and head angled down in the same direction. Its left hand supports the open flask, and its right hand holds the tilted kettle immediately above the flask opening. Both vessels and both hands are fully visible beneath the head, with no liquid stream yet visible.

panels.camera: Elevated oblique position looking down toward the serving side; extreme wide opening frame, 28mm-equivalent lens feel, deep focus.
panels.background: The green three-wheeler and canopy occupy the lower left, with the chipped upright visible beneath the canopy edge. The same kerb and road extend through the right half toward distant buildings and traffic.
panels.picture: Small beneath the canopy at lower left, the red mannequin stands with chest facing screen right, head inclined toward the counter, flask in its left hand and right hand beside the food tray. Two tiny grey commuters on the distant pavement are posed mid-step toward screen right, their chests and heads facing right and empty hands hanging beside their bodies. A small grey motorcycle rider farther along the road also faces screen right, both hands on the handlebars and feet on the rests.

panels.camera: Same standing-height roadside position as shot 1, looking across the counter; wide, 35mm lens feel, deep focus.
panels.background: The chipped green upright and shaded vehicle interior remain frame left. The road, kerb and a distant enclosed bus remain frame right, behind the customer approach.
panels.picture: The red mannequin stands screen left, chest facing right and head angled down toward the counter, holding the flask in its left hand and pressing the cloth against the steel surface with its right. The blue customer mannequin is screen right, side-on in a leftward step toward the counter, chest facing left and head tipped toward the prepared cup. Both blue hands are empty beside its body, and the cup rests between the figures near the customer edge, with the kettle farther inside the bay.

panels.camera: Counter-height side view from the established roadside half-plane; waist-up two-shot, 50mm lens feel, both figures and cup clear.
panels.background: Soft green fittings and the chipped upright remain frame left behind Kasun. The same road opening is softened at frame right behind the customer.
panels.picture: The red mannequin stands left with chest facing right and head turned toward the blue mannequin, retaining the flask in its left hand while its right rests beside the cloth. The blue mannequin stands right with chest facing left and head turned toward Kasun, its empty right hand poised beside the tea cup and its empty left hand lowered. The cup remains on the counter at lower centre-right, with clear space between the two mannequins' hands.

panels.camera: Counter height, customer-side oblique without crossing the serving axis; tight 85mm macro insert of cup and right hand.
panels.background: The scratched counter fills the lower background, with soft green fittings toward frame left. Daylight enters from frame right, where the road lies beyond the crop.
panels.picture: The ceramic tea cup stands large at centre on the steel counter. Only the blue mannequin's right forearm and hand enter from frame right, with the fingers poised beside the cup and not yet gripping it. The cup and hand fill the panel, with the rest of the mannequin outside the crop.

panels.camera: Standing head height on the roadside master line; medium-wide serving-bay composition, 35mm lens feel, deep focus.
panels.background: Cramped green fittings and the chipped canopy upright remain legible behind Kasun at frame left. A narrow road and kerb opening remains at frame right beyond the departing customer.
panels.picture: The red mannequin stands left behind the counter, chest and head still directed screen right toward the customer, flask in its left hand and right hand beside the cloth. At the right edge, the blue mannequin is side-on in a step toward screen right, with chest and head facing right rather than into the road's depth. Its right hand holds the tea cup clear of its body, and its empty left hand hangs beside its hip.

panels.camera: Standing head height just inside the bay, offset beside the fitting Kasun faces and looking outward; medium close-up, 65mm lens feel, shallow focus.
panels.background: Soft worn uprights bracket the red mannequin, with the green interior fitting concentrated at frame left. A wedge of the same bright road appears behind its right shoulder at frame right.
panels.picture: The red mannequin fills the left-centre between the worn uprights, chest facing diagonally into the bay toward frame left. Its head is tipped down toward a low fitting just left of the camera, presenting a three-quarter view rather than facing the lens. Both arms descend beyond the lower crop, with neither hand visible.

panels.camera: Standing head height from the roadside end of the serving bay, looking obliquely along the inward working line; close-up, 85mm lens feel, shallow focus.
panels.background: Narrow, softly separated green fittings occupy frame left behind Kasun. A slim road-lit opening remains at frame right, consistent with the roadside setups.
panels.picture: The red mannequin's head and upper shoulders fill the left-centre, with its chest still turned inward toward screen left. Its head remains angled down and left toward the vehicle fittings in a visible three-quarter profile, leaving a little open space at screen right. Both hands are below the crop.

panels.camera: Counter-height oblique from the established roadside side; extreme close insert, 85mm macro lens feel, shallow focus.
panels.background: The narrow scratched counter recedes behind the flask toward frame left, with soft green fittings farther left. Warm road light comes from frame right; the road itself is outside the crop.
panels.picture: The red mannequin's left forearm enters from frame left, and its left hand wraps steadily around the flask at centre. The thumb rests against the flask while the remaining fingers curve around its side. The hand and flask dominate the frame, with no other part of the mannequin visible.

panels.camera: Same counter-height three-quarter roadside position as shot 2; waist-up medium shot, 50mm lens feel.
panels.background: The same green fittings and chipped canopy upright remain frame left. Soft road brightness and empty customer space remain frame right.
panels.picture: The red mannequin stands left behind the counter with chest facing diagonally screen right and head turned toward the road on that side. Its left hand holds the flask, and its right hand rests on the beige cloth against the counter. The complete small working surface is visible below its arms, with no customer beside it.

panels.camera: Standing head height from the customer side, oblique to the serving bay; wide opening frame, 35mm lens feel, deep focus.
panels.background: The green body, chipped canopy upright and shaded preparation recess occupy frame left. The same kerb and road open at frame right, with distant enclosed traffic.
panels.picture: The complete counter extends across the lower frame, with the red mannequin working at screen left. Its chest faces diagonally left into the vehicle and its head is tipped toward the working surface. Its left hand retains the flask while its right presses the cloth flat against the counter, with the empty customer standing area open to the right.
